q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
# Analysis

## (a) Time left until resolution

Today is August 26, 2026. The earnings release is happening today (after market close). The forward guidance for Q3 FY2027 will be issued during tonight's earnings call. Resolution will occur within hours.

## (b) Most likely outcome and why

The question asks for NVIDIA's **forward guidance** in the Q2 FY2027 earnings release for **revenue**. Based on the research provided, this refers to the guidance for Q3 FY2027 revenue, which will be issued tonight.

Key facts from the research:
- NVIDIA issued guidance for Q2 FY2027 (the quarter just ended) of $91.0B ± 2% ($89.2B–$92.8B) on May 20, 2026
- Wall Street consensus for Q2 actual revenue is ~$91.8–$91.9B
- Q2 guidance represented a ~$9.4B sequential add from Q1 (a deceleration from Q1's $13.5B add)
- The forward guidance for Q3 is expected to be a significant driver of stock movement tonight

The range provided (99.5–115.5B) is substantially higher than the Q2 guidance of ~$91B, suggesting the market expects continued sequential growth from Q2 to Q3.

Historical pattern from the research: Q1→Q2 added ~$9.4B. If Q2→Q3 follows a similar or moderately faster trajectory (which is typical for NVIDIA's growth pattern during strong AI demand cycles), Q3 guidance would likely be in the range of:
- Conservative: Q2 midpoint (~$91B) + $9–10B = $100–101B
- Base case: Q2 midpoint (~$91B) + $10–12B = $101–103B  
- Bullish: Q2 midpoint (~$91B) + $13–15B = $104–106B

The provided range spans 99.5–115.5B, centered roughly around 107.5B. This suggests market expectations for meaningful but not explosive growth.

## (c) What would push the value lower?

- **Demand softness**: If enterprise/cloud customers signal reduced orders or spending plans
- **Supply chain constraints**: Production bottlenecks limiting shipments for Q3
- **China revenue disappointment**: The guidance explicitly excludes China compute revenue; any China-related developments could dampen overall growth expectations
- **Macro weakness**: Signs of AI capex slowdown among hyperscalers
- **Conservative management**: NVIDIA typically guides conservatively; they might be more cautious about Q3 given the deceleration already evident from Q1→Q2
- Expected lower bound of range: ~99.5B suggests market sees real downside risk

## (d) What would push the value higher?

- **Stronger demand than expected**: Hyperscalers accelerating AI infrastructure buildout
- **Better-than-expected utilization**: Higher pricing power or faster product ramp
- **Supply upside**: Better-than-expected production or yield improvements enabling higher shipments
- **Beats on Q2 actuals**: If Q2 actual revenue comes in well above the $91B guidance, management might guide higher for Q3
- **China developments**: Any positive changes to China export policy could add upside (though current guidance excludes this)
- Expected upper bound of range: ~115.5B suggests some market participants see significant upside

## (e) Base rate or historical reference values

From the research provided:
- Q1 FY2027 added ~$13.5B sequentially (from Q4 to Q1)
- Q2 FY2027 guidance suggests ~$9.4B sequential add (Q1→Q2 deceleration)
- This shows a slowdown trend, which might continue or stabilize
- NVIDIA's recent quarters show strong but decelerating sequential growth during this cycle

No other specific historical base rates are provided in the background or research.

---

## Reasoning toward estimate

The range 99.5–115.5B has a midpoint of 107.5B. The research strongly indicates:
1. Q2 revenue will be very close to the $91B guidance (Wall Street: $91.8–91.9B)
2. Sequential growth has decelerated from +$13.5B (Q1) to ~+$9.4B (Q2)
3. If this trend continues or stabilizes, Q3 should add another $9–12B → $100–103B range

However, the range provided extends to 115.5B, suggesting the market is pricing in possible acceleration. Given:
- NVIDIA's strong market position in AI chips
- Hyperscaler capex momentum continuing
- Typical seasonal patterns (Q3 often strong)
- But also visible deceleration trend and guidance conservatism

I estimate the distribution as:
- **Mode (most likely)**: ~102–105B (modest sequential growth continuation)
- **Upside tail**: 105–115B (if demand accelerates)
- **Downside tail**: 99.5–102B (if growth decelerates further or macro softens)

Given the 10th to 90th percentile framing:
- **10th percentile** (downside): ~100.5B (continued deceleration, macro caution)
- **50th percentile** (median): ~103.5B (steady sequential growth of $12–12.5B)
- **90th percentile** (upside): ~109.5B (acceleration, strong demand signals)

NVIDIA is scheduled to report its Q2 FY2027 earnings on Wednesday, August 26, 2026, after the U.S. market closes, with an analyst call following at 2 p.m. PT [piptheory.com](https://piptheory.com/research/nvidia-q2-fy2027-earnings-preview-august-2026).

For Q2 FY2027, NVIDIA's own guidance, issued on May 20, 2026, projected revenue of $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2% (a range of $89.2 billion to $92.8 billion) [nvidianews.nvidia.com](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-first-quarter-fiscal-2027), [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html), [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/), [ig.com](https://www.ig.com/en-ch/news-and-trade-ideas/nvidia-q2-fy2027-earnings-preview--what-to-watch-260825). This guidance explicitly "is not assuming any Data Center compute revenue from China" [nvidianews.nvidia.com](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-first-quarter-fiscal-2027), [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/). Wall Street consensus for Q2 revenue is slightly higher, at approximately $91.8 billion to $91.9 billion [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/), [ig.com](https://www.ig.com/en-ch/news-and-trade-ideas/nvidia-q2-fy2027-earnings-preview--what-to-watch-260825), [piptheory.com](https://piptheory.com/research/nvidia-q2-fy2027-earnings-preview-august-2026).

The forward guidance for Q3 FY2027, which will be released during the August 26 earnings call, is expected to be a significant driver for stock movement [ig.com](https://www.ig.com/en-ch/news-and-trade-ideas/nvidia-q2-fy2027-earnings-preview--what-to-watch-260825). The Q2 guidance represents a sequential revenue add of approximately $9.4 billion, a deceleration from the $13.5 billion added in Q1 FY2027 [piptheory.com](https://piptheory.com/research/nvidia-q2-fy2027-earnings-preview-august-2026).
